lead: Every week small asteroids fly past Earth, some closer than the Moon. This page shows NASA's real list, updated every day.
try: Tap any circle on the first chart to see that asteroid's size, speed and how close it came. Then try Chelyabinsk 2013.
points: Most asteroids that pass close are small, from a car to a building, and many are found only days before or after.
Small ones burn up in the air as bright fireballs. That happens somewhere on Earth every few weeks.
No known large asteroid is going to hit Earth in the next 100 years. Apophis passes very close in 2029, safely.
